rationale: A reusable source-independent semantic graph and binder contract already exists.

A4 HTML/iXBRL fields overlap semantically but are not shape-compatible with shared header_path/logical_table/axis/evidence contracts.
A thin HTML physical adapter and conservative iXBRL enrichment are required; a parallel FinancialColumnContextV1 or FinancialCellEvidenceV1 is not justified.
existing_continuation_table_support: yes, conservative three-state shadow/evaluation contract; automatic merge evidence is not production-ready
existing_column_period_binding: yes partially; point/duration and normalized periods, with explicit adapter needed for QUARTER/YTD
existing_currency_scale_unit_handling: yes; resolver hierarchy and deterministic operation unit contract
existing_stable_table_row_cell_identity: yes; adapter_identity and semantic fact IDs
genuinely_new_abstractions_required: one source adapter module at physical boundary; optional iXBRL metadata attachment, not a new evidence type
